senses.en: A place where people read or borrow books and other materials.
An organised collection of books, recordings, or digital resources.

ex.en: I reserved a study room at the library before the midterm.
ex.zh: 期中考试前，我在图书馆订了一间自习室。

ex.en: The library lends laptops so students can finish research when their own computers fail.
ex.zh: 图书馆出借笔记本电脑，方便学生在自己的电脑出故障时完成研究。

tip: library是借阅书籍的图书馆，bookshop是售书的书店。

senses.en: a person who studies at a school, college, or university

ex.en: Each student needs an ID card to enter the lab.
ex.zh: 每位学生都需要学生证才能进实验室。

ex.en: The survey asked every student how many hours they sleep during exam week.
ex.zh: 这项调查询问每位学生考试周睡多少小时。

tip: student不限于大学生；pupil主要指中小学生。

senses.en: an institution offering degree courses and conducting advanced research

ex.en: She chose the university because of its engineering program.
ex.zh: 她因为工程专业而选择了这所大学。

ex.en: The university requires first-year students to attend a short course on academic honesty.
ex.zh: 这所大学要求一年级学生参加一门关于学术诚信的短课。

tip: 用a university而非an，因开头发辅音/j/。

senses.en: A series of lessons about a particular subject.
The route something follows or the way events develop.
One part of a meal served separately from other parts.

ex.en: This course meets on Tuesdays in the science building.
ex.zh: 这门课每周二在科学楼上课。

ex.en: The course combines a weekly lecture with a smaller discussion section.
ex.zh: 这门课把每周一次的讲座和规模更小的讨论课结合在一起。

tip: course 是整门课程；lesson 是其中的一节课。

senses.en: A book of blank pages for writing notes.
A small portable computer with a folding screen.

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on a spiral notebook.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论螺旋装订笔记本。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss a spiral notebook.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论螺旋装订笔记本的材料。

col: write in a notebook｜在笔记本上写
a spiral notebook｜螺旋装订笔记本
tip: 通常指纸质笔记本；电脑义也可说notebook computer。

senses.en: A formal test of knowledge or ability.

ex.en: Our professor circled exam results on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了考试成绩。

ex.en: In the lecture on student life, everyone remembered the example of exam results.
ex.zh: 在关于校园生活的讲座里，大家都记得考试成绩这个例子。

col: revise for an exam｜复习备考
tip: exam是examination的常用缩写；参加考试用take。

senses.en: A group learning together, or a lesson they attend.
A social group or category sharing particular characteristics.
To place someone or something in a particular category.

ex.en: Our professor circled social class on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了社会阶层。

ex.en: In the lecture on student life, everyone remembered the example of social class.
ex.zh: 在关于校园生活的讲座里，大家都记得社会阶层这个例子。

tip: in class通常指在上课；in the class指在这个班里。

senses.en: Schoolwork that students are asked to complete outside lessons.
Research or preparation done before making a decision.

ex.en: Our professor circled hand in homework on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了交作业。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss hand in homework.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论交作业的材料。

col: do your homework｜做好事前准备
tip: 不可数名词；一项作业用a piece of homework。

senses.en: An institution offering education beyond school, including practical or academic courses.
A constituent institution or division within a university.

ex.en: Office hours began with community college.
ex.zh: 答疑从社区学院开始。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss community college.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论社区学院的材料。

col: go to college｜上大学或学院
tip: 美式常泛指大学；英式多指学院或继续教育院校。

senses.en: A university teacher, especially one holding a senior academic position.

ex.en: The professor posted the slides after class.
ex.zh: 教授课后上传了课件。

ex.en: The professor asked us to question the method before accepting the conclusion.
ex.zh: 教授让我们在接受结论之前先质疑研究方法。

tip: 英国通常指高级职称；美国也泛指大学教师。

senses.en: A short piece of writing exploring a particular subject.

ex.en: His essay opened with a clear claim.
ex.zh: 他的文章以一个明确的主张开头。

ex.en: A strong essay explains the evidence before it states what the evidence implies.
ex.zh: 一篇好的文章会先解释证据，再说明证据意味着什么。

col: an essay on｜一篇关于……的文章
tip: 可数名词；一篇关于某主题的文章用an essay on。

senses.en: A particular way of doing something.
An organized and systematic approach to an activity.

ex.en: We changed the method after the first trial failed.
ex.zh: 第一次试验失败后，我们改了方法。

ex.en: The passage contrasts a traditional method with a newer way to measure sleep.
ex.zh: 文章把一种传统方法和一种更新的睡眠测量方式做了对比。

tip: 常用a method of/for doing sth表示做事的方法。

senses.en: The natural world, including land, water, air, and living things.
The conditions and surroundings in which someone lives or works.

ex.en: Noise in the dorm affects the study environment.
ex.zh: 宿舍里的噪音会影响学习环境。

ex.en: The lecture linked a warming environment to changes in when plants flower.
ex.zh: 讲座把变暖的环境与植物开花时间的变化联系了起来。

tip: 泛指自然环境常用the environment。

senses.en: the way a person or animal acts
the way a substance or system acts under particular conditions

ex.en: Sleep loss can change a student's behavior in class.
ex.zh: 睡眠不足会改变学生在课堂上的行为。

ex.en: Researchers recorded behavior during the task so they could compare the two groups.
ex.zh: 研究者记录了任务过程中的行为，以便比较两组受试者。

tip: 美式拼写；英式为behaviour。通常不可数。

senses.en: The activity of entering words using a keyboard.

ex.en: Office hours began with touch typing.
ex.zh: 答疑从盲打开始。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss touch typing.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论盲打的材料。

tip: 作名词时不可数；也是type的现在分词。

senses.en: Relating to men or boys, or the sex that produces sperm.
A male person or animal.

ex.en: The textbook introduces male students in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了男学生。

ex.en: The author returns to male students when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了男学生。

col: male and female｜男性和女性；雄性和雌性
tip: male可作形容词或名词；日常指男人通常用man。

senses.en: A collection of recorded music released as one product.
A book for keeping photographs, stamps or similar collections.

ex.en: The textbook introduces debut album in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了首张专辑。

ex.en: The author returns to debut album when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了首张专辑。

tip: 音乐专辑用album；单曲用single。

senses.en: plan how something will look or work before making it
the planning of something's appearance or function, or its plan
a decorative pattern on an object or surface

ex.en: The professor asked us to design a building.
ex.zh: 教授让我们设计建筑。

ex.en: When the class discussed the humanities, the speaker told us to design a building.
ex.zh: 全班讨论人文学科时，讲者让我们设计建筑。

col: be designed to do something｜旨在做某事
tip: be designed to do表示“旨在做……”。

senses.en: A four-stringed instrument held under the chin and usually bowed.

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about violin lessons.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于小提琴课的简答题。

ex.en: The author returns to violin lessons when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了小提琴课。

col: a violin concerto｜小提琴协奏曲
tip: 小提琴手是violinist；拉小提琴常说play the violin。

senses.en: speaking or behaving without respect for others

ex.en: Office hours began with rude behaviour.
ex.zh: 答疑从粗鲁的行为开始。

ex.en: In the lecture on social change, everyone remembered the example of rude behaviour.
ex.zh: 在关于社会变迁的讲座里，大家都记得粗鲁的行为这个例子。

tip: 对某人无礼用 rude to someone，不用 rude with。

senses.en: To make the sounds of a word when speaking.
To state an official decision or judgment.

ex.en: In office hours we practiced how to pronounce a word.
ex.zh: 答疑时我们练习如何读出单词。

ex.en: In the sample listening, the professor pauses to pronounce a word.
ex.zh: 在示例听力里，教授停下来读出单词。

col: pronounce someone innocent｜宣布某人无罪
tip: 名词是pronunciation，注意中间没有字母o。

senses.en: the skill or power needed to do something

ex.en: Office hours began with academic ability.
ex.zh: 答疑从学业能力开始。

ex.en: The author returns to academic ability when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了学业能力。

col: the ability to learn｜学习能力
develop an ability｜培养一种能力
tip: 表示“做某事的能力”用ability to do。

senses.en: a device that captures sound, images, or information
a wooden or plastic wind instrument with finger holes
a person who keeps an official record

ex.en: The textbook introduces digital recorder in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了数字录音机。

ex.en: The author returns to digital recorder when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了数字录音机。

tip: play the recorder指吹竖笛，不是播放录音机。

senses.en: A valuable yellow metal used for jewellery and money
The medal awarded for first place in a competition
Made of gold or having its yellow colour

ex.en: The textbook introduces pure gold in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了纯金。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss pure gold.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论纯金的材料。

tip: gold作材料名通常不可数；a gold可指一枚金牌。

senses.en: the way a word or language is spoken

ex.en: Our professor circled clear pronunciation on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了清晰的发音。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss clear pronunciation.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论清晰的发音的材料。

tip: 拼写是pronunciation，注意中间不是noun。

senses.en: The food and drink someone regularly consumes.
A planned way of eating for health or weight control.
To control what you eat, usually to lose weight.

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on a balanced diet.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论均衡饮食。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss a balanced diet.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论均衡饮食的材料。

col: a diet rich in fibre｜富含纤维的饮食
go on a diet｜开始节食
tip: diet不一定指节食，也可指日常饮食。

senses.en: A country's military force trained mainly to fight on land.
A large group of people working toward a shared purpose.

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about an army of volunteers.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于大批志愿者的简答题。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around an army of volunteers.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕大批志愿者展开说明。

col: serve in the army｜在陆军服役
an army of volunteers｜大批志愿者
tip: army主要指陆军；armed forces泛指各军种。

senses.en: relating to society and how people live together
relating to meeting people and spending time with them
living naturally in organised groups rather than alone

ex.en: Our professor circled social inequality on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了社会不平等。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around social inequality.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕社会不平等展开说明。

tip: social指社会或社交的；sociable指人爱交际。

senses.en: The currency used by many countries in the European Union.

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about the euro area.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于欧元区的简答题。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss the euro area.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论欧元区的材料。

tip: 普通英语中复数通常为euros；并非所有欧盟国家都用欧元。

senses.en: an instruction stating what is allowed or required
control of a country or people by a leader or group
to govern a country or make an official legal decision

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on rule out.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论排除。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss rule out.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论排除的材料。

tip: as a rule意为“通常”；rule out意为“排除”。

senses.en: the son of your son or daughter

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on youngest grandson.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论最小的孙子或外孙。

ex.en: The reading connects youngest grandson with a larger point about social change.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把最小的孙子或外孙和关于社会变迁的一个更大的问题联系起来。

col: youngest grandson｜最小的孙子或外孙
eldest grandson｜最大的孙子或外孙
tip: 不区分父系与母系，既指孙子也指外孙。

senses.en: a cloth symbol representing a country, group, or organisation
to mark something as needing attention
to become weaker or less energetic

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on national flag.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论国旗。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss national flag.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论国旗的材料。

tip: 动词过去式flagged，进行式flagging，双写g。

senses.en: To become someone's husband or wife.
To perform the ceremony that makes two people legally married.

ex.en: In office hours we practiced how to marry young.
ex.zh: 答疑时我们练习如何年纪轻轻就结婚。

ex.en: Careful notes from the talk include a reminder to marry young.
ex.zh: 听课笔记里写着要记得年纪轻轻就结婚。

tip: 说marry someone或get married to，不说marry with。

senses.en: A person who uses a product, service, or facility.

ex.en: Our professor circled road user on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了道路使用者。

ex.en: In the lecture on technological change, everyone remembered the example of road user.
ex.zh: 在关于技术变革的讲座里，大家都记得道路使用者这个例子。

tip: use作动词及user中的s读/z/。

senses.en: a lightweight manufactured material that can form many different shapes
made of plastic
able to be shaped or changed easily

ex.en: The textbook introduces single-use plastic in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了一次性塑料。

ex.en: In the lecture on environmental policy, everyone remembered the example of single-use plastic.
ex.zh: 在关于环境政策的讲座里，大家都记得一次性塑料这个例子。

tip: 表示塑料材料时通常不可数；a plastic指一种塑料。

senses.en: A green vegetable with thick stems and tightly clustered flower buds.

ex.en: The textbook introduces steamed broccoli in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了蒸西兰花。

ex.en: In the lecture on public health, everyone remembered the example of steamed broccoli.
ex.zh: 在关于公共卫生的讲座里，大家都记得蒸西兰花这个例子。

col: a head of broccoli｜一整颗西兰花
tip: 通常不可数；小朵西兰花可说broccoli florets。

senses.en: To keep someone or something safe from harm or damage

ex.en: In office hours we practiced how to protect the environment.
ex.zh: 答疑时我们练习如何保护环境。

ex.en: The passage says students who can protect the environment follow the argument more easily.
ex.zh: 文章说，能够保护环境的学生更容易跟上论点。

col: protect from harm｜保护……免受伤害
tip: 常用protect sb/sth from或against，表示免受伤害。

senses.en: the mother of your husband or wife

ex.en: I wrote mother-in-law on a note card with its meaning.
ex.zh: 我把mother-in-law和它的意思写在了笔记卡上。

ex.en: A reading on social change uses mother-in-law when the author sets up the main claim.
ex.zh: 一篇关于社会变迁的阅读在提出主要主张时用到了婆婆。

col: future mother-in-law｜未来的婆婆或岳母
supportive mother-in-law｜给予支持的婆婆或岳母
tip: 指配偶的母亲；复数mothers-in-law。

senses.en: A website or page with regularly added posts.
To write and publish posts on a blog.

ex.en: The textbook introduces travel blog in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了旅行博客。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss travel blog.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论旅行博客的材料。

col: blog about something｜写关于某事的博客
tip: 一篇博文叫a blog post；blog常指整个博客。

senses.en: using electronic systems that store and process information as digits

ex.en: Our professor circled digital technology on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了数字技术。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss digital technology.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论数字技术的材料。

tip: digital侧重数字技术；表示“数字上的”常用numerical。

senses.en: Showing respect and consideration for other people.

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about polite request.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于礼貌的请求的简答题。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss polite request.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论礼貌的请求的材料。

col: polite to someone｜对某人有礼貌
tip: 对某人有礼貌用be polite to，不用polite with。

senses.en: The strength and enthusiasm needed for physical or mental activity
Power used to produce heat, movement, light, or electricity

ex.en: The textbook introduces full of energy in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了精力充沛。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around full of energy.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕精力充沛展开说明。

tip: 表示精力或能源时通常不可数，不说 an energy。

senses.en: the group of people officially controlling a country or region
the activity or system of controlling a country

ex.en: Office hours began with local government.
ex.zh: 答疑从地方政府开始。

ex.en: A campus survey used local government to explain a pattern in public institutions.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用地方政府来解释公共制度中的一种模式。

tip: 英国英语中，指政府群体时可接单数或复数谓语。

senses.en: in a way that is accurate or follows the rules

ex.en: The professor told us to correctly identify and then compare notes.
ex.zh: 教授让我们正确识别，然后比较笔记。

ex.en: A lecture on academic research asks the class to correctly identify before trusting a chart.
ex.zh: 关于学术研究的讲座要求全班在相信图表之前先正确识别。

col: if I remember correctly｜如果我没记错
tip: 修饰动作；correct是形容词或动词，不作副词使用。

senses.en: treating people equally or reasonably
having pale skin or light hair
an event where people display or sell goods and services

ex.en: The textbook introduces trade fair in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了贸易展览会。

ex.en: A campus survey used trade fair to explain a pattern in social change.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用贸易展览会来解释社会变迁中的一种模式。

tip: fair指待遇公平；fairly还可表示“相当”。

senses.en: An object used to build, repair, or make things.
Something that helps you perform a task or achieve something.

ex.en: I copied a useful tool into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把实用工具抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss a useful tool.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论实用工具的材料。

col: a tool for learning｜学习工具
tip: tool是可数名词；equipment通常不可数。

senses.en: the joint connecting your foot to your leg

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on a swollen ankle.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论肿胀的脚踝。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss a swollen ankle.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论肿胀的脚踝的材料。

tip: ankle指脚与小腿连接处，不是脚后跟heel。

senses.en: The effort to succeed against others seeking the same goal.
An organised event in which people try to win.

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on fierce competition.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论激烈竞争。

ex.en: The reading connects fierce competition with a larger point about social change.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把激烈竞争和关于社会变迁的一个更大的问题联系起来。

tip: 表示竞争通常不可数；表示一场比赛时可数。

senses.en: to talk about something and exchange ideas
to examine a subject in speech or writing

ex.en: The professor asked us to discuss a problem.
ex.zh: 教授让我们讨论问题。

ex.en: Careful notes from the talk include a reminder to discuss a problem.
ex.zh: 听课笔记里写着要记得讨论问题。

col: discuss something with someone｜与某人讨论某事
tip: 直接接讨论内容：discuss sth，不加about。

senses.en: A small amount of food eaten between main meals.
To eat small amounts of food between main meals.

ex.en: Our professor circled a healthy snack on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了健康零食。

ex.en: A campus survey used a healthy snack to explain a pattern in public health.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用健康零食来解释公共卫生中的一种模式。

col: snack on nuts｜吃坚果当零食
tip: 动词常用snack on sth，表示吃某物当零食。

senses.en: a representation showing how something looks, works, or is organised
someone or something that provides a good example to follow
a person who displays clothes or poses for artists

ex.en: Office hours began with scale model.
ex.zh: 答疑从比例模型开始。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around scale model.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕比例模型展开说明。

tip: model还可作动词，表示建模或当模特。

senses.en: lacking physical strength or energy
not effective, convincing, or well supported
having little intensity, flavour, or power

ex.en: The textbook introduces weak evidence in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了薄弱的证据。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around weak evidence.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕薄弱的证据展开说明。

tip: weak与week同音；weakness可指弱点，也可指虚弱。

senses.en: To design or make something that did not exist before.
To make up a story or excuse that is untrue.

ex.en: The lab instructions say to invent a device.
ex.zh: 实验说明要求发明装置。

ex.en: When the class discussed technological change, the speaker told us to invent a device.
ex.zh: 全班讨论技术变革时，讲者让我们发明装置。

tip: invent是创造新事物；discover是发现已有事物。

senses.en: to find something or learn something previously unknown

ex.en: Before Friday's seminar, our group has to discover a cure.
ex.zh: 周五研讨课之前，我们小组必须发现疗法。

ex.en: In the sample listening, the professor pauses to discover a cure.
ex.zh: 在示例听力里，教授停下来发现疗法。

col: discover a new species｜发现新物种
tip: discover发现原本存在的事物；invent创造新事物。

senses.en: Someone who plans how something will look or work.
Made by a famous fashion designer, usually expensive.

ex.en: Our professor circled fashion designer on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了时装设计师。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss fashion designer.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论时装设计师的材料。

tip: 作形容词常置于衣物等名词前，强调设计师品牌。

senses.en: A child who attends school.
The dark opening in the eye that lets light enter.

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on primary school pupil.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论小学生。

ex.en: A campus survey used primary school pupil to explain a pattern in academic research.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用小学生来解释学术研究中的一种模式。

tip: 英式英语常指中小学生；大学生用 student。

senses.en: The words someone knows or uses in a language.
The words used in a particular subject or activity.

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on expand your vocabulary.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论扩大词汇量。

ex.en: A campus survey used expand your vocabulary to explain a pattern in academic research.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用扩大词汇量来解释学术研究中的一种模式。

col: a limited vocabulary｜有限的词汇量
tip: 单个词用word；vocabulary通常指词汇总量或集合。

senses.en: A thin paper tube filled with tobacco for smoking.

ex.en: Office hours began with cigarette smoke.
ex.zh: 答疑从香烟烟雾开始。

ex.en: The reading connects cigarette smoke with a larger point about public health.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把香烟烟雾和关于公共卫生的一个更大的问题联系起来。

col: a packet of cigarettes｜一包香烟
tip: 可数名词；一包香烟可说a packet of cigarettes。

senses.en: Using, producing, or relating to electricity.
Full of excitement and energy.

ex.en: I copied electric car into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把电动汽车抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: In the lecture on technological change, everyone remembered the example of electric car.
ex.zh: 在关于技术变革的讲座里，大家都记得电动汽车这个例子。

tip: 电动设备多用electric；电气系统多用electrical。

senses.en: armed fighting between countries or groups
a determined effort to defeat something harmful

ex.en: Our professor circled civil war on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了内战。

ex.en: The author returns to civil war when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了内战。

col: war on poverty｜消除贫困的斗争
tip: 表示处于交战状态用at war，不加冠词。

senses.en: A person who reads, especially books, newspapers, or magazines
A device that displays written material or reads stored information
A book designed to help learners develop reading skills

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on an avid reader.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论热衷阅读的人。

ex.en: The reading connects an avid reader with a larger point about academic research.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把热衷阅读的人和关于学术研究的一个更大的问题联系起来。

col: an avid reader｜热衷阅读的人
tip: reader既可指人，也可指设备或供学习的读物。

senses.en: The process of learning or teaching knowledge and skills.

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on higher education.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论高等教育。

ex.en: In the lecture on academic research, everyone remembered the example of higher education.
ex.zh: 在关于学术研究的讲座里，大家都记得高等教育这个例子。

col: access to education｜受教育的机会
tip: 通常不可数；但可说a good education（良好教育）。

senses.en: A distinctive way of doing something or expressing ideas.
The design of something or a fashionable appearance.
To arrange or design something to achieve a particular look.

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on writing style.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论写作风格。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss writing style.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论写作风格的材料。

col: style your hair｜给头发做造型
tip: style可指个人风格，不一定表示流行时尚。

senses.en: A trained person who cares for ill or injured people.
To care for someone who is ill or injured.

ex.en: I copied registered nurse into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把注册护士抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: The author returns to registered nurse when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了注册护士。

col: nurse someone back to health｜照料某人直至康复
tip: 作动词可直接接人：nurse a patient。

senses.en: No longer married because the marriage legally ended.
Separated from something that should be closely connected.

ex.en: The textbook introduces divorced parents in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了离异父母。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss divorced parents.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论离异父母的材料。

tip: get divorced表示离婚；脱离某事用divorced from。

senses.en: The idea that a word, action, or message communicates.
The importance or purpose that makes something worthwhile.

ex.en: The textbook introduces literal meaning in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了字面意思。

ex.en: The reading connects literal meaning with a larger point about academic research.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把字面意思和关于学术研究的一个更大的问题联系起来。

col: the meaning of a word｜词义
give meaning to life｜赋予生活意义
tip: 问词义用the meaning of；不要与opinion混淆。

senses.en: regularly moving, doing things, or taking part
currently working or producing an effect
describing a verb whose subject performs the action

ex.en: The textbook introduces an active lifestyle in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了积极运动的生活方式。

ex.en: The author returns to an active lifestyle when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了积极运动的生活方式。

col: an active lifestyle｜积极运动的生活方式
play an active role｜发挥积极作用
tip: active指积极活动或参与；不等于表示乐观的positive。

senses.en: Available through the internet or connected to a computer network.
Using the internet or while connected to a computer network.

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about available online.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于可在网上获取的的简答题。

ex.en: The reading connects available online with a larger point about technological change.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把可在网上获取的和关于技术变革的一个更大的问题联系起来。

tip: 既可作形容词，也可作副词：shop online。

senses.en: someone who plays music, especially professionally

ex.en: I copied professional musician into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把职业音乐人抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: The reading connects professional musician with a larger point about the humanities.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把职业音乐人和关于人文学科的一个更大的问题联系起来。

tip: musician指音乐人；作曲家更具体地用composer。

senses.en: a building where Christians gather to worship
Christian religious worship attended as a service
an organized group of Christians sharing beliefs and practices

ex.en: Office hours began with attend church.
ex.zh: 答疑从参加礼拜开始。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss attend church.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论参加礼拜的材料。

tip: go to church指做礼拜；go to the church指去教堂。

senses.en: A grand official home for a royal or important leader.

ex.en: I copied royal palace into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把王宫抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: In the lecture on historical change, everyone remembered the example of royal palace.
ex.zh: 在关于历史变迁的讲座里，大家都记得王宫这个例子。

tip: 主要用作名词；palace gardens中作名词定语。

senses.en: the activity of taking food into your body
taking food into your mouth and swallowing it

ex.en: I copied healthy eating into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把健康饮食抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: The reading connects healthy eating with a larger point about public health.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把健康饮食和关于公共卫生的一个更大的问题联系起来。

tip: eating可作动名词；eat out表示外出就餐。

senses.en: Practical use of scientific knowledge, especially through tools and machines.

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on digital technology.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论数字技术。

ex.en: The reading connects digital technology with a larger point about technological change.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把数字技术和关于技术变革的一个更大的问题联系起来。

tip: 泛指科技时不可数；多种具体技术可用technologies。

senses.en: A set of connected parts that work together.
An organised structure through which services or institutions operate.
An organised way of doing something.

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on heating system.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论供暖系统。

ex.en: The reading connects heating system with a larger point about technological change.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把供暖系统和关于技术变革的一个更大的问题联系起来。

col: public transport system｜公共交通系统
tip: systematic指有条理的，systemic指全系统的。

senses.en: A unit of length equal to one hundredth of a metre.

ex.en: Our professor circled square centimetre on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了平方厘米。

ex.en: The author returns to square centimetre when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了平方厘米。

tip: 英式拼写centimetre，美式centimeter；缩写cm。

senses.en: the scientific study of living things
the natural processes and characteristics of a living thing

ex.en: I copied marine biology into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把海洋生物学抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: The reading connects marine biology with a larger point about the natural sciences.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把海洋生物学和关于自然科学的一个更大的问题联系起来。

tip: 学科名称，通常不可数；生物学家是biologist。

senses.en: Someone who creates pictures using paint.
Someone whose job is painting buildings or other surfaces.

ex.en: Office hours began with a landscape painter.
ex.zh: 答疑从风景画家开始。

ex.en: In the lecture on the humanities, everyone remembered the example of a landscape painter.
ex.zh: 在关于人文学科的讲座里，大家都记得风景画家这个例子。

tip: 既可指艺术画家，也可指刷墙的油漆工。

senses.en: Something discussed, studied, or taught.
Affected by something or dependent on a condition.
To make someone experience something, especially something unpleasant.

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about school subject.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于学校科目的简答题。

ex.en: The reading connects school subject with a larger point about academic research.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把学校科目和关于学术研究的一个更大的问题联系起来。

col: subject someone to stress｜使某人承受压力
tip: 动词重音在后：/səbˈdʒekt/；常用subject A to B。

senses.en: Two people who are married or in a romantic relationship.
Two things or people, or a small number of them.
To join two things or consider them together.

ex.en: Our professor circled a married couple on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了一对已婚夫妇。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around a married couple.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕一对已婚夫妇展开说明。

col: a married couple｜一对已婚夫妇
tip: a couple of后接复数名词，可指两个或少数几个。

senses.en: a small, flat piece of metal used as money
to invent a new word or expression

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about a gold coin.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于金币的简答题。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around a gold coin.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕金币展开说明。

tip: coin作动词常指创造词语，如coin a term。

senses.en: Something done to achieve a result or address a problem.
A particular thing that someone does.
Exciting events in a story, film, or real situation.

ex.en: The textbook introduces urgent action in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了紧急行动。

ex.en: The reading connects urgent action with a larger point about social change.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把紧急行动和关于社会变迁的一个更大的问题联系起来。

tip: take action中的action不可数；具体举动可用actions。

senses.en: A surface on which electronic images or films appear.
To check people or things for problems or suitability.
To show a film or programme to an audience.

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about touch screen.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于触摸屏的简答题。

ex.en: The author returns to touch screen when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了触摸屏。

tip: screen A for B表示检查A是否存在B问题。

senses.en: A large fortified building with thick walls and towers.

ex.en: Our professor circled medieval castle on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了中世纪城堡。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss medieval castle.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论中世纪城堡的材料。

tip: castle中的t不发音；palace指宫殿。

senses.en: Written words, especially the main written content of something.
A short written message sent using a phone.
Send someone a short written message using a phone.

ex.en: I copied plain text into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把纯文本抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: The author returns to plain text when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了纯文本。

tip: 文字内容通常不可数；一条短信可说a text。

senses.en: something that happens because of an action or event
the final score or outcome of a test or competition
to happen because of something or cause something to happen

ex.en: Our professor circled result in on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了导致。

ex.en: A campus survey used result in to explain a pattern in academic research.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用导致来解释学术研究中的一种模式。

tip: result in后接结果；result from后接原因。

senses.en: A set of keys used to enter information into a computer

senses.zh: 乐器键盘；电子键盘乐器
senses.en: A musical instrument's keys, or an electronic instrument with keys

ex.en: Office hours began with wireless keyboard.
ex.zh: 答疑从无线键盘开始。

ex.en: The author returns to wireless keyboard when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了无线键盘。

col: play the keyboard｜弹电子键盘乐器
tip: 电脑键盘常说a keyboard；演奏键盘乐器用play the keyboard。

senses.en: Energy carried by charged particles, used to power devices

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about generate electricity.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于发电的简答题。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss generate electricity.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论发电的材料。

tip: electricity不可数；electric多指用电的，electrical指电相关的。

senses.en: something made or grown to be sold or used
something that results from a process or situation
the result of multiplying two or more quantities

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about product development.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于产品开发的简答题。

ex.en: In the lecture on economic policy, everyone remembered the example of product development.
ex.zh: 在关于经济政策的讲座里，大家都记得产品开发这个例子。

tip: product是产品或结果，production是生产过程。

senses.en: A room or building equipped for scientific experiments and tests

ex.en: The textbook introduces research lab in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了研究实验室。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around research lab.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕研究实验室展开说明。

tip: lab是laboratory的常用缩写，二者均为可数名词。

senses.en: Someone qualified to advise people about law and represent them.

ex.en: Our professor circled criminal lawyer on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了刑事律师。

ex.en: In the lecture on social change, everyone remembered the example of criminal lawyer.
ex.zh: 在关于社会变迁的讲座里，大家都记得刑事律师这个例子。

tip: lawyer是律师的统称，区别于法官judge。

senses.en: the name given to a book, film, or other work
a name indicating someone's rank, position, or professional role
the position of winner in a sporting competition

ex.en: Office hours began with book title.
ex.zh: 答疑从书名开始。

ex.en: The author returns to book title when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了书名。

tip: title是标题或名称；topic是讨论的主题。

senses.en: a machine that produces paper copies of digital documents or images
a person or business that prints books and other materials

ex.en: The textbook introduces laser printer in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了激光打印机。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss laser printer.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论激光打印机的材料。

tip: print是打印；printer可指机器，也可指印刷从业者。

senses.en: Entertainment intended to make people laugh.
The humorous quality of a situation or event.

ex.en: The textbook introduces romantic comedy in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了浪漫喜剧。

ex.en: The author returns to romantic comedy when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了浪漫喜剧。

tip: 指喜剧类型时通常不可数；一部喜剧用a comedy。

senses.en: A group or show featuring acrobats, clowns, and other performers.

ex.en: Office hours began with travelling circus.
ex.zh: 答疑从巡回马戏团开始。

ex.en: The reading connects travelling circus with a larger point about the humanities.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把巡回马戏团和关于人文学科的一个更大的问题联系起来。

tip: 可指马戏团或表演；复数为circuses。

senses.en: Use more of something than necessary or without useful results.
Unwanted material left after something has been used or made.
An unnecessary or unproductive use of time, money, or resources.

ex.en: The assignment is to waste time, then say why it matters.
ex.zh: 作业是先浪费时间，再说明它为什么重要。

ex.en: In the sample listening, the professor pauses to waste time.
ex.zh: 在示例听力里，教授停下来浪费时间。

col: a waste of money｜浪费金钱
tip: 用waste time doing sth，通常不用to do。

senses.en: the head of state in a country without a monarch
the person leading an organisation, company, club, or university

ex.en: The textbook introduces university president in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了大学校长。

ex.en: In the lecture on public institutions, everyone remembered the example of university president.
ex.zh: 在关于公共制度的讲座里，大家都记得大学校长这个例子。

tip: 可指总统，也可指机构负责人；具体译法看语境。

senses.en: Sleeping rather than awake.

ex.en: The textbook introduces fast asleep in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了熟睡的。

ex.en: The author returns to fast asleep when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了熟睡的。

tip: asleep通常作表语；“熟睡的婴儿”用a sleeping baby。

senses.en: Someone who gathers and presents news for the public.

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about news reporter.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于新闻记者的简答题。

ex.en: The author returns to news reporter when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了新闻记者。

tip: reporter侧重新闻采访报道；journalist涵盖范围更广。

senses.en: A female monarch, or the wife of a king.
The main egg-laying female in a social insect colony.
The chess piece that moves any distance in any direction.

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on the reigning queen.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论在位女王。

ex.en: The reading connects the reigning queen with a larger point about public institutions.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把在位女王和关于公共制度的一个更大的问题联系起来。

tip: queen 可指统治国家的女王，也可指国王的妻子。

senses.en: The work of helping people learn knowledge or skills.
Ideas or principles taught by a person or tradition.

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on a career in teaching.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论教师职业生涯。

ex.en: The reading connects a career in teaching with a larger point about academic research.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把教师职业生涯和关于学术研究的一个更大的问题联系起来。

col: a career in teaching｜教师职业生涯
tip: 指教学时不可数；指教义或学说常用teachings。
